title: Crash when opening resources in the inspector
body:
### Tested versions

reproducible in 4.6.1 and latest

### System information

windows 10 & linux

### Issue description

In my project, the editor crashes after opening certain resources in the inspector.
So far I've seen it happen with materials, shaders and related resources, so I suspect something is connected there?
We were able to reproduce this on windows and linux on 3 different machines

Attached is a video of what happens

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b27e876d-d29c-4758-8cfe-abfc42a992b3
